# First public release

Omarchy Watch turns the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-2.06 development board
into a Bluetooth companion for Omarchy 4.

## Highlights

- Omarchy-themed time, date, weather, location, and battery display
- automatic color synchronization with the active Omarchy theme
- secure Bluetooth LE pairing and background reconnection
- Codex working state and completion alerts with a configurable speaker chime
- low-power display, CPU, and Bluetooth behavior
- Omarchy bar panel for pairing, sync, brightness, sound, and diagnostics

## Install

Follow the [installation guide](https://github.com/iamjamesim/omarchy-watch#install).
The attached flash bundle supports Espressif esptool 4.x and 5.x. It writes the
three firmware regions separately and preserves pairing and watch settings
during an upgrade.

This is an independent community project for development hardware, not an
official Omarchy product or a waterproof consumer watch.
